guitar.notes: French rock band, no documented iconic signature instrument.

tone.target: jangly clean-to-edge breakup with chorus wash and light delay
tone.profile: jangly clean-to-edge breakup with chorus wash and light delay
tone.summary: A classic jangly setup using a clean preamp (US Deluxe/Silver Twin) paired with Chorus for wash, followed by light delay and room ambience to capture the required brightness and vintage feel.

rig.name: Louise Attaque - Ton Invitation - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly lift the high end for jangliness and attack.
blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of a dedicated EQ to maintain clean signal path while adding brightness.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal clean and focused on natural breakup.
blocks.gap: The target requires only light breakup, making a dedicated drive unit unnecessary; relying on amp saturation is better.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a clean, bright American/British combo amp tone (Vox-like).
blocks.gap: US Deluxe is the closest model for a clean, chimey sound; UK 45 or Silver Twin could also work but US Deluxe fits the 'jangly' requirement best.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the clean tone.
blocks.gap: The target suggests 4x10 or 2x12; US 2x12 is chosen for its inherent brightness and focus on single-coil sounds.

blocks.purpose: Add the required wash and movement to the clean tone.
Address the 'drop mid-scoop' correction and enhance brightness/jangliness.
blocks.gap: Using a parametric EQ to fine-tune the frequency response as requested by the musical verdict.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required light delay effect.
Add subtle space and ambience without muddying the jangly tone.
blocks.gap: Room reverb is chosen over Plate/Spring to provide a natural, open acoustic feel suitable for this style of pop-rock.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by selecting an IR that better matches the required Vox/British clean sound.

proposals.reason: Better captures the classic British chime and open sound needed for jangly pop-rock.
